automodpack.restart.update: The modpack update be ready to sail.
automodpack.restart.select: The server's required modpack be chosen.
automodpack.restart.automodpack: AutoModpack now matches the version the server demands.
automodpack.restart.description: Restart the game to play, ye scurvy dog.
automodpack.restart.toast.title: A restart might fix this
automodpack.restart.toast.description: Th' modpack's current mods may not be loaded. Restart th' game an' join again.
automodpack.selection.title: Pickin' yer groups
automodpack.selection.description: Pick the optional bits o' the modpack ye want.
automodpack.selection.restartRequired: Restart the game to make yer changes stick.
automodpack.selection.updateOnLaunchDisa: "Update modpack on launch" be off. Turn it on, or run a manual update, or this choice stays in port.
automodpack.selection.categoryExplanatio: Category buttons pick their groups. AutoModpack stows those picks apart from the groups ye choose one by one.
automodpack.firstConnect.title: Set up this modpack
automodpack.firstConnect.description: Look over the default loot before ye download.
automodpack.confirm.leftoverTooltip: Checked keeps these files in th' mods folder. Unchecked tosses them from th' mods folder an' stashes a copy on th' instance timeline. Applies to: %s
automodpack.confirm.intro: This here server, %s, offers a modpack through AutoModpack.
automodpack.confirm.matchedHonesty: All mod files for this pack were spotted on Modrinth or CurseForge. Those ports watch for malware, but some can slip past. They also can't see what several mods can do chained together.
automodpack.confirm.computerRisk: Mods in any modpack be just programs that run on yer ship. They can change files, steal yer secrets, or hand yer ship to another captain. That don't mean they will.
automodpack.confirm.commands: Inspect the files before ye download. If yer launcher has a sandbox, turn it on. If ye barely know the crew runnin' this server, or ye don't trust 'em, don't download.
automodpack.confirm.unverifiedCount: %s of %s mod files weren't found on Modrinth or CurseForge.
automodpack.confirm.unverifiedExplain: They could be harmless custom mods, tinkered mods, or cursed mods. AutoModpack can't tell which.
automodpack.confirm.ack: I know the risk and trust this crew.
automodpack.confirm.ackCountdown: The risk box unlocks in %s seconds.
automodpack.confirm.ackUnlock: Tick the risk box to unlock.
automodpack.validation.identity.purpose: This screen makes sure ye connect to the server ye mean to join.
automodpack.validation.identity.paste: Get the full fingerprint from the server's cap'n. Paste it in the field. If the fingerprint matches, no other ship sits in the middle of this connection.
automodpack.validation.identity.notPack: This screen don't examine the modpack. A matchin' fingerprint don't mean the modpack is safe to use.
automodpack.validation.identity.publicly: This prompt only appears for certificates that ain't publicly trusted. A server with a publicly trusted certificate be accepted without it.
automodpack.validation.identity.methodHi: This be one method AutoModpack uses to check a certificate. Press the ? button to learn more.
automodpack.patchNotes.latest: Latest captain's notes from th' server
automodpack.summary.restartOffered: Ye will be asked to restart
automodpack.packManager.title: Installed modpacks
automodpack.packManager.description: Pick a pack to look at its groups. Tappin' a row does not put it at the helm.
automodpack.packManager.empty: No complete modpack records on this client. The hold be empty.
automodpack.pinnedMods.title: Pinned client mods
automodpack.pinnedMods.warning: These ids stay in the default mods folder for every pack in this instance. AutoModpack still downloads the pack copy but does not load it. If that breaks a pack, that is on ye. Restart the game to apply.
automodpack.pinnedMods.liveTooltip: Keep this live jar and skip loadin' the pack copy of the same id.
automodpack.pinnedMods.missingTooltip: No jar with this id be in the mods folder, so the pack copy still loads. Remove the id or add the jar.
automodpack.pinnedMods.empty: No jars in the mods folder yet. Type a mod id to pin it for later.
automodpack.packManager.switchDescriptio: Look this pack and its groups over before ye switch.
automodpack.packDetails.title: Modpack settings
automodpack.packDetails.description: Pick one deed for this installed modpack.
automodpack.changelog.latestNote: Latest captain's note from th' server: %s
automodpack.browser.empty: No files match. The nets came up empty.
automodpack.browser.conflicts.other: %s local files conflict with this modpack. Continuin' keeps them on th' instance timeline.
automodpack.browser.conflicts.one: %s local file conflicts with this modpack. Continuin' keeps it on th' instance timeline.
automodpack.browser.copyHashTooltip: Click to copy this here file's SHA-1 hash.
automodpack.error.details: The full tale be in the log file.
automodpack.error.hostContent: AutoModpack could not read the server modpack. Hail the server cap'n.
automodpack.error.connection: AutoModpack could not reach the modpack host.
automodpack.error.storage: AutoModpack could not update the local hold.
automodpack.error.update: AutoModpack could not apply the modpack update.
automodpack.error.corruptState: AutoModpack found rotten local modpack data.
automodpack.validation.title: Certificate check
automodpack.validation.fingerprint.label: Server fingerprint (shortened):
automodpack.validation.confirm.text: Paste the full fingerprint to check:
automodpack.validation.failed: The fingerprints do not match. A false flag may be flyin'.
automodpack.validation.skip.title: Security risk
automodpack.validation.skip.warning1: Skip this and attackers can smuggle in cursed mods.
automodpack.validation.skip.warning2: Mods can rifle through yer files and run whatever code they please.
automodpack.validation.skip.instruction: Skip only if ye know what ye be doin'.
automodpack.validation.skip.confirm.text: Type the phrase below, if ye dare:
automodpack.storage.title: Local hold
automodpack.storage.description: Swabbin' frees loot-history file data that th' instance timeline doesn't pin.
automodpack.storage.removes: Tosses: file data that only older pack generations still point at, an' data nothin' points at anymore. Doesn't toss instance timeline snapshots.
automodpack.storage.keeps: Keeps: yer active generation an' th' newest, every generation's notes, yer editable files, an' every instance snapshot still on th' timeline.
automodpack.storage.compacted: Cleaned on %s: loot-history generations older than #%s can no longer be dug up on this ship.
automodpack.storage.stateHistoryKept: Ship's timeline snapshots keep their bytes till ye use Ferget older on th' timeline.
automodpack.storage.verifying: Hold check be runnin'. Ye can leave this screen. It'll finish safe.
automodpack.storage.verificationReceipt: %s of %s referenced objects be sound (%s). All required objects be intact.
automodpack.storage.running: Swabbin' be runnin'. Ye can leave this screen. It'll finish safe.
automodpack.pin.invalid: Bad pinned address. Paste the full address the server cap'n gave ye.
automodpack.pin.removeConfirm: Click again to cut the pin loose
automodpack.pinMismatch.title: Certificate don't match!
automodpack.pinMismatch.happened: The certificate this server presented don't match the certificate pinned for this address. The connection was stopped.
automodpack.pinMismatch.meaning: This can mean the server certificate was rotated or the server moved to a new address. It can also mean someone be interceptin' the connection.
automodpack.pinMismatch.do: Ask the server cap'n about the change through a channel ye trust. If the change be real, they can give ye a pinned address to add, or ye can cut the old pin loose on the server edit screen and reconnect to check the new certificate.
automodpack.pinMismatch.dont: Don't cut the pin loose just to get past this screen. The pin be what stops an impostor from servin' ye mods from this address.
automodpack.originChange.title: A new server address
automodpack.originChange.installed: The modpack %s be set up from: %s
automodpack.originChange.nowServed: Ye be joinin' from %s, which be not on that list.
automodpack.originChange.explain: Servers often sail to new waters, or fly several addresses for one modpack. It can also mean someone be imitatin' the server. If ye didn't expect this, refuse and ask the server cap'n through a channel ye trust.
automodpack.originChange.remember: Allowin' remembers this address for this modpack. AutoModpack won't be askin' again.
automodpack.detached.title: Modpack not synced
automodpack.detached.localState: Ye be playin' a locally kept state o' %s. Ye chose not to take the server's newer modpack, so yer current files be kept as they be.
automodpack.detached.risk: The server may be expectin' different files: joinin' may fail or the game may capsize.
automodpack.detached.sameGeneration: The server be sailin' the generation ye kept. Whate'er ye changed stays exactly as it be, and the server cannot update it 'til ye sync.
automodpack.detached.syncAnytime: Ye can sync to the server's current modpack at any time.
automodpack.offer.title: A modpack be offered
automodpack.offer.serverModpack: This server be carryin' a modpack through AutoModpack. Sync it to yer game before ye board?
automodpack.offer.syncAnytime: Ye can sync to the server's modpack at any time later.
automodpack.changelog.title: Changelog
automodpack.history.title: Loot history
automodpack.history.description: Published generations o' this pack, with notes. Restore uses files already on this ship.
automodpack.history.notRestorableTooltip: This version's files are not kept on this computer, so it cannot be restored.

automodpack.files.description: The whole installed modpack file list.

automodpack.selection.defaultSelected: Default: selected unless ye toss it
automodpack.selection.savedInvalid: Some saved picks cannot share a ship. Change the marked ones to carry on.
automodpack.selection.cannotSelect: %s cannot be picked with this modpack setup.
automodpack.selection.sourcesCancelled: Third-party sources: lookup canceled. Server download still be open
automodpack.selection.sourcesResolved: Third-party sources: %s / %s files matched. The rest come from the server

automodpack.repair.healthy: Managed files passed every integrity check. Shipshape.
automodpack.repair.hashed: Checked %s files (%s) on disk. No cached result was reused.
automodpack.repair.updateNeeded: Some files be missin' locally. An update can haul in replacements.
automodpack.repair.updateNeededOffline: Some files be missin' locally. Update when the server be around.
automodpack.stateHistory.title: Ship's timeline
automodpack.stateHistory.description: %s snapshots o' this instance, newest first. Restore puts th' runnin' instance back to that moment. Sync stays off 'til ye resume.
automodpack.stateHistory.empty: No snapshots yet. Th' first AutoModpack deed on this instance starts th' timeline.
automodpack.stateHistory.restoreReady: Puts this instance back to that snapshot. Packs aboard stay in th' list. Sync stays off 'til ye resume.
automodpack.stateHistory.restoreCurrent: Th' runnin' instance already matches this snapshot.
automodpack.stateHistory.restoreNotKept: This snapshot's files be no longer kept on this ship.
automodpack.stateHistory.restoreFileRead: Puts th' file back where it was. Refuses to overwrite a different file.
automodpack.stateHistory.restoreFileOwne: Th' active pack owns this path, so it can't be restored while th' pack be usin' it. Stash a copy instead.
automodpack.stateHistory.restoreFileMana: Only game-folder files can be put back to their original path.
automodpack.stateHistory.restoreFileProt: This be th' runnin' AutoModpack itself. Restorin' over it could leave th' game unable to update.
automodpack.stateHistory.restoredTo: Put th' file back to its original path.
automodpack.stateHistory.savedTo: Stashed a copy in th' recovered folder.

automodpack.update.reviewDeactivation: Review the files restored when deactivatin'.
automodpack.update.reviewRemoval: Review the files that will be scuttled.
automodpack.update.reviewRollback: Review the files this version puts back.
automodpack.update.rollbackDetaches: Restorin' this version also stops syncin' this modpack 'til ye resume.

automodpack.selection.categoryTooltip: Click to include every optional group in this category. Click again to cast them all off.
automodpack.management.deactivateTooltip: Takes the modpack off duty. Its files stay, so ye can man it again.
automodpack.management.stopSyncingToolti: Keeps e'ery file exactly as it be and stops takin' the server's updates 'til ye resume.
automodpack.management.resumeSyncingTool: Syncs this pack to the server's current generation.
